authorization: User: validate stability and, if unstable, add calibration scenes excluding the actual 1000 comparison scenes.

model_binding.code_organization: Ten-layer checkpoint with accepted message_gem phase estimation; conditional known-phase route retained

objective: One fixed threshold per baseline across the six SNRs; minimize total user errors, ties fewer false alarms then smallest threshold.
ordering: Run 700 calibration scenes first; freeze all four thresholds using old 1000 + new 700, then run the 300 verification scenes.
verification: Report all four methods, all six SNRs, misses/false alarms and paired changes versus old eight-SNR thresholds and old six-SNR calibration-only optima. Do not select policies using verification outcomes.
policy_adoption: Candidate only. No official experiment, baseline selection, C-STMP configuration, or pilot continuation is changed.
timing: Concurrent calibration throughput only. Skip timing warmups; each formal receiver case runs once. No latency comparisons.
stop_policy: STOP.json stops between saved receiver results; preserve all saved outputs. No automatic retry or restart after failure.

seed_separation.limitation: Seed identity separation, not a universal audit of every historical training bank.
